info.name: ERDDAP REST Data Access Metadata API
Get variable and attribute metadata for a dataset

params.name: datasetID
params.description: Unique dataset identifier (visible in search results as the `ID` column).

items.docs:
Returns a table describing every variable and global attribute in the
dataset. Each row is one of:

| Row Type  | Variable Name | Attribute Name | Data Type | Value |
|-----------|--------------|----------------|-----------|-------|
| attribute | NC_GLOBAL    | title          | String    | ...   |
| variable  | time         |                | double    |       |
| attribute | time         | units          | String    | seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z |

Use this response to discover variable
